info.name: Messaging Service
info.description:
Messaging Service (WebSocket-Only Architecture). All chat messaging operations are handled exclusively via Socket.IO at `/socket.io`. HTTP endpoints are limited to service health checks.

**Connect**: `ws://localhost:4000/socket.io` (gateway) or `ws://localhost:4005/socket.io` (direct)
**Auth**: `auth: { token: "<accessToken>" }` on socket init, or `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header.

request.description: Returns service status — confirms Messaging Service runs on Socket.IO only.
Health probe for PM2 / load balancer.

item.name: Socket.IO Events (Reference)
item.description:
All chat operations run over Socket.IO. Each item below documents one event: its emit payload, expected acknowledgement shape, and any server-broadcast side effects.

These requests use GET as a placeholder — they are non-runnable documentation items. Use a Socket.IO client (e.g. Postman WebSocket tab, socket.io-client, or the Flutter app) to test them.

**Connection URL**: `ws://{{host}}/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket`
**Auth**: `socket = io(url, { auth: { token: accessToken } })`

request.description:
Start or retrieve an existing conversation between a customer and an expert.

**Direction**: Client → Server (with ack)

**Emit payload** (one of):
```json
{ "expertId": "<expertProfileId>" }    // customer initiating
{ "customerId": "<customerProfileId>" } // expert initiating
```

**Ack response**:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "id": "<conversationId>", "peer": {...}, "createdAt": "..." } }
```

**Side effect**: Emits `conversation:new` to peer's user room `user:<peerUserId>` when a new conversation is created.

**Figma screens**: Expert Profile (Message button), XprtLink Chat List

Join a conversation room to receive real-time messages. Must be called before sending or receiving messages in a specific thread.

**Direction**: Client → Server (with ack)

**Emit payload**:
```json
{ "conversationId": "<uuid>" }
```

**Ack response**:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "conversationId": "<uuid>", "joined": true } }
```

Client is added to Socket.IO room `conversation:<conversationId>`.

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - Media & Context

Leave a conversation room. Call when navigating away from a chat thread.

**Direction**: Client → Server (with ack)

**Emit payload**:
```json
{ "conversationId": "<uuid>" }
```

**Ack response**:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "conversationId": "<uuid>", "left": true } }
```

Client is removed from Socket.IO room `conversation:<conversationId>`.

Send a text or media message to a conversation. At least one of `body` or `mediaIds` is required.

**Direction**: Client → Server (with ack)

**Emit payload**:
```json
{
  "conversationId": "<uuid>",
  "body": "Hello!",
  "mediaIds": []
}
```

**Ack response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "<msgId>",
    "conversationId": "<uuid>",
    "senderUserId": "<uuid>",
    "body": "Hello!",
    "type": "text",
    "mediaUrls": [],
    "deliveryStatus": "sent",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-19T09:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Side effects**:
- Broadcasts `message:new` to room `conversation:<conversationId>` (all joined members)
- Broadcasts `conversation:updated` to peer's user room `user:<peerUserId>` (inbox update)

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - Media & Context (send button)

Server-to-client broadcast when a new message arrives in a joined thread.

**Direction**: Server → Room Broadcast (`conversation:<conversationId>`)

**Payload received by client**:
```json
{
  "conversationId": "<uuid>",
  "message": {
    "id": "<msgId>",
    "senderUserId": "<uuid>",
    "body": "Hello!",
    "type": "text",
    "mediaUrls": [],
    "createdAt": "2026-08-19T09:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - real-time incoming message bubble

Server-to-client broadcast to update the conversation inbox list when a peer sends a new message.

**Direction**: Server → Peer User Room (`user:<peerUserId>`)

**Payload received by client**:
```json
{
  "conversationId": "<uuid>",
  "lastMessage": {
    "body": "Hello!",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-19T09:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "senderUserId": "<uuid>"
}
```

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Chat List - unread badge update, last message preview

Mark all messages in a conversation as read. Resets the unread counter for this user.

**Direction**: Client → Server (with ack)

**Emit payload**:
```json
{ "conversationId": "<uuid>" }
```

**Ack response**:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "read": true, "unreadCount": 0 } }
```

**Side effect**: Broadcasts `conversation:read` to room `conversation:<conversationId>` so the peer sees the read receipt.

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation (open chat = mark read)

Read receipt broadcast to active thread participants.

**Direction**: Server → Room Broadcast (`conversation:<conversationId>`)

**Payload received by client**:
```json
{
  "conversationId": "<uuid>",
  "userId": "<uuid>",
  "readAt": "2026-08-19T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - double-tick read indicator

Signal that this user has started typing. Triggers `typing:status` broadcast to other thread members.

**Direction**: Client → Server (fire-and-forget, no ack)

**Emit payload**:
```json
{ "conversationId": "<uuid>" }
```

**Side effect**: Broadcasts `typing:status` `{ conversationId, userId, isTyping: true }` to `conversation:<id>`.

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - typing indicator bubble

Signal that this user has stopped typing (cleared input or sent message). Triggers `typing:status` broadcast.

**Direction**: Client → Server (fire-and-forget, no ack)

**Emit payload**:
```json
{ "conversationId": "<uuid>" }
```

**Side effect**: Broadcasts `typing:status` `{ conversationId, userId, isTyping: false }` to `conversation:<id>`.

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - typing indicator disappears

Server-to-client broadcast indicating a peer's typing state changed.

**Direction**: Server → Room Broadcast (`conversation:<conversationId>`)

**Payload received by client**:
```json
{
  "conversationId": "<uuid>",
  "userId": "<uuid>",
  "isTyping": true
}
```

**Figma screens**: XprtLink Conversation - animated typing dots
